thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency on /v1/streaming/generate exceeded 2.5s for the last 5m, error rate stable. Auto-slo rule triggered. link: https://telemetry.redwood/services/inference/alerts/4076543210
elyse (oncall): Acknowledging, jumping in. Starting triage.
jamal: I'm tailing the serving logs now, seeing a big uptick in cache-miss-rate for prefixcache_p95 and p99. Query: `sum(rate(prefix_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (shard)` shows cluster-wide spike.
sandeep: FYI I rolled out prefix-hash v2 to canary earlier at 4076538000, canary report looked fine but didn't run load profile. Could be a key normalization mismatch.
maya: Can you paste the canary config? I want to check salt/namespace flags.
sandeep: config snippet: ```json
{"prefix_hash_version":"v2","salt":"s1","namespace":"prod"}
```
jamal: On the live nodes I'm seeing new keys that don't match existing namespace mapping. Hitrate dropped from ~92% to ~18% across hot shards. That explains tail tokens being served from origin and causing stalls.
elyse (oncall): Do we have a quick mitigation path? Rolling back the canary or warming the cache?
sandeep: Easiest immediate: 1) rollback prefix-hash flag on canaries and stop rollout, 2) force route traffic away from affected canary pool, 3) spin up cache-warmers for hot prefixes. I can rollback in ~2m.
jamal: While sandeep rolls back, I'll increase request timeouts on streaming workers to avoid client disconnects and set fallback-policy to older model variant for routes hitting >1s. Command: `./infractl route update --path /v1/streaming --fallback-model redwood/gpt-small --timeout 6s`
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline: rollback-prefixhash-v2 started by sandeep at 4076543450. Build 0.0.123 -> promoted to canary stop. CI checks passed.
sandeep: Rollback applied to canaries, halting rollout. Confirming configs reverted.
maya: After rollback, cache keys are still cold. We should run a prefetch for top N prefixes. I have a script: `scripts/prefetch_top_prefixes.sh --window 24h --top 5000`
elyse (oncall): Run prefetch, but make sure it respects rate caps. Use batch size 20.
maya: Starting prefetch now against warm pool with throttling. Logs: `prefetch started 5000 prefixes, expected duration ~7m`
tess (cs): Heads up — CS reported one paying customer (AcmeCorp) saw degraded latency, opened a support ticket at 4076543300. They saw streaming stalls for ~10m. I'll patch them with status updates.
elyse (oncall): Thanks Tess. Assigning to maya for customer-impact note and to jamal/sandeep for technical details for postmortem.
jamal: Post-rollback metrics: cache-hit-rate recovering from 18% -> 65% within 4m after prefetch and rollback. p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 0.7s, p99 from 3.2s -> 0.9s. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/services/inference/dashboards/prefixcache?from=4076543000&to=4076544200
sandeep: Root cause hypothesis: v2 hash introduced a subtle normalization change for trailing colons in prefix keys; keys diverged. Missed in canary because traffic profile skewed.
maya: Action items: 1) revert rollout (done), 2) deploy hotfix that adds compatibility layer (v2 -> v1 fallback) 3) add canary load test with representative streaming traffic 4) prefetch script + automations, 5) customer comms draft.
elyse (oncall): I'm creating an incident ticket: INC-407654 (latency spike / prefix-hash regression). Assigning owner: sandeep. Please escalate to SEV2.
incident-bot: Incident INC-407654 created by elyse (oncall) at 4076543670. Severity: SEV2. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/prefixcache-regression.
tess (cs): Sent AcmeCorp update: "We're mitigating a prefix cache issue causing transient latency. We rolled back a config change and are warming caches. ETA recovery ~10-20m."
jamal: Next steps before handoff: monitor p99 for 30m, let prefetch finish, validate no other model routes affected. I'll stay on for 20m.
elyse (oncall): Handoff plan: I need a short list for the next oncall.
elyse (oncall): HANDOFF -> next oncall @jamal at 4076543910. Remaining tasks: ["monitor p95/p99 for /v1/streaming for 30m","validate prefetch completed and hit-rate >85%","confirm rollback propagated to all canaries and stopped","start compatibility hotfix branch and run canary load test","coordinate customer follow-up with Tess"]
jamal: Acknowledged handoff. I'll pick up at 4076543910. Leaving a short note in INC-407654 with log snippets, prometheus queries, and commands used.
elyse (oncall): Thanks team :thumbsup: Great coordination. We'll capture root cause and add a pre-deploy load test in the rollout playbook.
devops-bot: Note: rollback completed on all targeted canaries at 4076543485. No further rollout traffic for prefix-hash v2 observed.
incident-bot: Incident INC-407654 status -> mitigated (p99 recovered to <1s). Will leave open for postmortem.
jamal: Adding to postmortem: include timeline, missed canary load profile, mitigation steps (rollback + prefetch), customer impact summary.
maya: I'll open a PR with the prefetch automation and add a smoke load test to canary pipeline.
tess (cs): I'll follow up with AcmeCorp and offer a 1:1 postmortem call.
elyse (oncall): Final note: keep this thread intact for postmortem writeup. Closing live bridge. :lock:
